required_inputs: Admissible selected-null contexts with tree reconstruction, edge action, focal sibling context, feature family, parent sizes, projection dimension, spectral summaries, and barycentric balance.
required_outputs: Context-level held-out tail calibration, admissibility status, residual-tail error, and failure reasons.
acceptance_criteria: Pass only when every promoted context has >=499 matching simulations, <=5% c-hat simulation SE, and residual-tail exceedance within alpha plus two binomial SEs on held-out folds.
blocks_method_claim_until: No external calibration law may be used outside contexts passing the selected-tail admissibility and held-out absolute-tail checks.

required_inputs: Non-root selected records with ancestor Tree-BH path actions, depths, edge p-values, selected hierarchy ratios, and matched simulation ids.
required_outputs: Path-conditioned c-hat, selected-ratio tail quantiles, support counts, and comparison against path-relaxed contexts.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when adding ancestor-path variables changes c-hat and q95 ratio by less than 10% in all admissible non-root contexts; otherwise path conditioning is mandatory.
blocks_method_claim_until: Non-root external laws cannot borrow root or path-relaxed calibration until path-stability passes.

required_inputs: Fixed-tree, ancestor-path, focal-blocker, and full-reconstruction runs with common seeds and null/planted labels.
required_outputs: Layer attribution table with false-split rate, selected-ratio distortion, edge rejection, and support failures by baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when the full-reconstruction baseline is present and every shortcut baseline is explicitly marked conservative, anti-conservative, or attribution-only.
blocks_method_claim_until: Selection diagnostics must report full reconstruction before any shortcut diagnostic can support a method claim.

required_inputs: Gaussian null and planted Gaussian contexts across parent size, projection dimension, covariance condition, and barycentric balance.
required_outputs: Gaussian admissibility table, c-hat precision, selected-ratio q95/q99, and blocker explanation by support status.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when Gaussian blocker contexts become admissible and held-out exceedance is calibrated at sibling alpha 0.01.
blocks_method_claim_until: Gaussian blocker claims remain diagnostic until the selected-tail law explains support-failure contexts without overborrowing.

required_inputs: Broad selected-geometry records including edge action, p/n, parent size, projection dimension, feature family, spectral geometry, and barycentric variables.
required_outputs: Six-model Q5 validation table plus source-family, non-root, categorical, continuous, and phylogenetic transfer summaries.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when the compact barycentric edge/spectral model or successor has calibrated held-out absolute tails in every promoted family.
blocks_method_claim_until: Q5 may guide diagnostics but not production external calibration until broad transfer passes.

required_inputs: Internal calibration decisions plus external selected-tail context rows carrying admissibility and held-out tail metrics.
required_outputs: Unified decision table with internal_admissible, undefined support failures, and external_admissible states.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when external_admissible is only returned for contexts satisfying Q1/Q7 tail and support contracts.
blocks_method_claim_until: The external decision branch must remain disabled until promotion criteria are implemented and tested.

required_inputs: Independent matching simulations, matched selected records, c-hat SE, empirical tail resolution, and held-out folds per context.
required_outputs: Admissibility table with support, precision, tail resolution, and held-out exceedance pass/fail columns.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when all promoted contexts satisfy >=499 simulations, >=499 records, <=5% relative c-hat SE, and valid held-out tail precision.
blocks_method_claim_until: No selected-tail estimate is production-admissible without this row-level contract.

required_inputs: Predeclared context variables and candidate stratifiers: case, family, n, p, projection, parent-size bin, edge action, spectral summaries, topology, and barycentric leverage.
required_outputs: Exact-match versus modeled-tail comparison with support fragmentation and tail calibration metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when the selected context schema reaches support without hidden data-adaptive bins and preserves held-out absolute-tail calibration.
blocks_method_claim_until: Context variables remain descriptive until the schema is predeclared and support-admissible.

required_inputs: Internal calibration decisions with positive-weight records, effective sample size, max weight share, leave-one stability, strict/stopped support, and barycentric balance.
required_outputs: Threshold grid reporting false-split rate, undefined rate, c-hat stability, and planted-signal retention.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when one threshold tuple controls null false splits while preserving planted power across support regimes.
blocks_method_claim_until: Sparse-context enforcement must stay opt-in until the threshold grid passes.

required_inputs: Mixed null/signal sibling records with true support labels, edge p-values, selected ratios, and calibration outcomes.
required_outputs: Weight-rule grid with labeled-support calibration, effective support, false-split rate, and stability.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when a rule improves support stability without increasing labeled-null false splits or selected-nonnull leakage.
blocks_method_claim_until: The current product-BH rule remains default until labeled support validation selects a replacement.

required_inputs: Calibration decisions over exact and relaxed axes for parent size, family, projection, spectral geometry, and barycentric balance/leverage.
required_outputs: Bandwidth grid with c-hat variance, undefined rate, false-split rate, and support concentration.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when a bandwidth rule has stable c-hat under leave-one-record and matched-context perturbations in admissible contexts.
blocks_method_claim_until: Bandwidth remains implementation default rather than validated method constant.

required_inputs: Fixed projection matrices, known covariance nulls, independent subtree samples, and feature-family covariance models.
required_outputs: Proof checklist plus simulated p-value uniformity and chi-square QQ summaries under fixed projection.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when assumptions are stated as theorem hypotheses and simulations show calibrated p-values under those hypotheses.
blocks_method_claim_until: Projected chi-square claims must be scoped to fixed, valid projections until selected-basis theory passes.

required_inputs: Selected PCA bases with and without internal rows, selected barycenter maps, and fixed-subspace controls.
required_outputs: Selected-PCA distortion table with p-value calibration, basis-selection variables, and tail inflation.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when selected-basis p-values are calibrated or a correction law is validated against fixed-subspace controls.
blocks_method_claim_until: Fixed-projection proof is insufficient for selected-PCA method claims.

required_inputs: Local spectra, effective independent rows, backend eigenvalue scale, selected-tree variables, and barycentric balance.
required_outputs: Identity/deformed/finite-null MP comparison with projection dimension, calibration, and power endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when an MP threshold rule controls null projection selection and preserves planted contrast power after selection.
blocks_method_claim_until: The MP rule remains a diagnostic/default heuristic until selected/deformed MP validation passes.

required_inputs: Full benchmark grid over kmin values with zero-dimensional semantics, calibration support, ARI, and false-split labels.
required_outputs: Floor grid reporting support failures, over/under-splits, null false splits, ARI, and dimension distributions.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when one floor has acceptable null control, no unsupported semantic gaps, and competitive planted power.
blocks_method_claim_until: Do not change kmin default from smoke evidence alone.

required_inputs: Leaf-only selected-nonnull contexts with no strict/stopped support, external admissibility rows, and planted/null labels.
required_outputs: Decision table comparing fail-closed, external selected-tail, and candidate all-selected support policies.
acceptance_criteria: Pass only if a policy controls null false splits without borrowing selected-nonnull rows as empirical null support.
blocks_method_claim_until: All-selected-nonnull contexts must fail closed until this contract passes.

required_inputs: Selected-geometry rows crossed with null/planted labels, dimension-rule candidates, spectral summaries, and barycentric balance.
required_outputs: Dimension-rule grid with p-value calibration, power, support failure, and rule-difference metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when a rule is calibrated under null and retains planted sibling contrast power across balance strata.
blocks_method_claim_until: Current dimension-rule grid remains descriptive without null/power endpoints.

required_inputs: Fixed-tree multinomial one-hot nulls over cardinality, imbalance, parent size, and drop-last covariance conditioning.
required_outputs: Categorical projected-Wald p-value calibration by cardinality and simplex-face proximity.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when fixed-tree categorical p-values are calibrated before same-data selection is introduced.
blocks_method_claim_until: Categorical selected-tree claims are blocked by fixed-tree multinomial calibration failures.

required_inputs: High-cardinality categorical panels crossing covariance model, projection rule, sibling FDR layer, edge alpha, and barycentric boundary distance.
required_outputs: Factorial attribution table for covariance, FDR, projection, selection, and simplex-boundary effects.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when the dominant failure source is isolated with stable effect sizes across seeds and cardinalities.
blocks_method_claim_until: Do not tune categorical defaults until the failure source is separated.

required_inputs: Continuous Gaussian nulls over n, p, covariance condition number, dense covariance guardrails, and selected-tree settings.
required_outputs: Dense covariance calibration table with p-value uniformity, runtime feasibility, and support behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when dense empirical covariance is calibrated and computationally admissible for the claimed continuous domain.
blocks_method_claim_until: p >> n continuous production claims require a validated alternative covariance model.

required_inputs: Continuous p >> n null/planted panels for shrinkage, low-rank, diagonal, and Wasserstein/Gaussian-barycenter covariance candidates.
required_outputs: Candidate covariance comparison with calibration, power, stability, and runtime/memory metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when one regularized model dominates dense fallback on calibration and power in p >> n contexts.
blocks_method_claim_until: No regularized continuous covariance model may be claimed until implemented and validated.

required_inputs: Discretized Gaussian data with known latent and observed nulls, Bernoulli/categorical approximations, and selected spectra.
required_outputs: Approximation-contract table comparing Bernoulli, categorical, and latent-Gaussian references.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when one reference family gives calibrated p-values and stable selected spectra over discretization levels.
blocks_method_claim_until: Discretized Gaussian cases remain benchmark variants without production distributional interpretation.

required_inputs: Mixed Bernoulli, categorical, and continuous blocks with per-block nulls, cross-block independence/dependence settings, and planted signals.
required_outputs: Mixed-feature calibration table with blockwise and aggregate projected-Wald p-values.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when blockwise contracts compose without inflating aggregate false splits.
blocks_method_claim_until: Mixed-feature method claims need this block-composition validation.

required_inputs: Traversal trees with valid synthetic p-values, fixed-tree Wald p-values, selected-tree Wald p-values, and active calibration decisions.
required_outputs: Layered traversal FDP, false rejection, support failure, and final-cluster false-split metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when the active traversal layer controls the declared target under null and reports planted recovery under signal.
blocks_method_claim_until: Traversal-aligned FDR remains unproved until active-layer null simulations pass.

required_inputs: Candidate error targets over edge path, traversal depth, selected hierarchy, and final clusters.
required_outputs: Target comparison table with estimand definition, FDP/FWER estimate, and method compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when one target is mathematically defined and empirically estimable with valid diagnostics.
blocks_method_claim_until: Sibling FDR language must stay qualified until the target is chosen.

required_inputs: Pass-through runs with same-evidence scores, descendant evidence, parent size, projection dimension, and barycentric balance.
required_outputs: Ablation table for baseline pass-through, no pass-through, same-evidence penalty, and barycentric-balance penalty.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when the penalty reduces null over-splitting without losing planted descendant recovery.
blocks_method_claim_until: Barycentric pass-through claims need an implemented ablation.

required_inputs: Predeclared tau functions using same evidence, descendant evidence, n, dimension, and barycentric balance.
required_outputs: Threshold-function grid with null over-split, planted under-split, and sensitivity metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when one tau function has stable null and planted behavior across families.
blocks_method_claim_until: No tau functional form should enter production without grid validation.

required_inputs: Benchmark suite with pass-through on/off, threshold variants, null and planted labels, and final cluster counts.
required_outputs: Under-split/over-split/ARI table by traversal policy.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when pass-through improves under-splits without unacceptable null over-splitting under a declared criterion.
blocks_method_claim_until: Pass-through remains an algorithmic policy until this ablation is locked.

required_inputs: Tree-valued phylogenetic objects with Frechet/BHV barycenters, clade nulls, and Euclidean-control embeddings.
required_outputs: Tree-space false-split calibration and comparison to ordinary Euclidean summaries.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when tree-space barycenter variance controls direct sibling false splits inside null clades.
blocks_method_claim_until: Phylogenetic claims remain future work until tree-valued nulls exist.

required_inputs: All benchmark cases with oracle recoverability, gate traces, metric/linkage settings, calibration statuses, and final outcomes.
required_outputs: Failure taxonomy manifest assigning gate, metric, linkage, calibration, representation, or recoverability labels.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when every failed case has exactly one primary label and optional secondary labels with supporting metrics.
blocks_method_claim_until: Benchmark failure narratives remain incomplete until taxonomy coverage is total.

required_inputs: Tree-unrecoverable cases with oracle cuts, alternate metrics/linkage, gate traces, and representation settings.
required_outputs: Required diagnostic checklist and manifest before metric/linkage changes.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when every tree_unrecoverable case has oracle, metric, linkage, and gate diagnostics.
blocks_method_claim_until: Do not change metrics/linkage for unrecoverable cases without the checklist.

required_inputs: Diffuse Gaussian, heavy-overlap, and SBM cases crossed by representation, metric, linkage, gate constants, and calibration state.
required_outputs: Ablation table separating representation, distance, linkage, and gate contributions.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when each case family has a stable primary failure source across seeds.
blocks_method_claim_until: Case-family fixes should wait for factor attribution.

required_inputs: Candidate benchmark outputs, code commit, run commands, seeds, endpoints, confidence intervals, and limitations.
required_outputs: Locked manuscript-results manifest with include/exclude rationale and frozen artifact paths.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when every manuscript result references a locked artifact with reproducible provenance.
blocks_method_claim_until: No result should be called manuscript-ready without locked provenance.

required_inputs: Method constants with benchmark-performance grids, null calibration grids, planted power, and decision rules.
required_outputs: Constant evidence manifest separating benchmark default, calibrated default, and implementation default.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when each constant has complete required fields and a declared decision status.
blocks_method_claim_until: Constants remain implementation defaults or benchmark defaults until evidence manifests are complete.

required_inputs: Null feature families with fixed-tree and selected-tree controls across edge alpha and hierarchy reconstruction modes.
required_outputs: Edge Type-I table with frontier rejection, all-edge rejection, final false splits, and categorical fixed-tree diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when edge alpha controls the declared null edge target under the selected-tree regime or a correction is validated.
blocks_method_claim_until: Edge alpha remains benchmark-supported rather than Type-I justified.

required_inputs: Sibling alpha grid with null selected-tree calibration, planted sibling contrasts, support decisions, and final clusters.
required_outputs: Null/power curve for sibling alpha with active calibration and support-failure accounting.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when alpha 0.01 or a replacement controls null target and retains planted power.
blocks_method_claim_until: Sibling alpha remains benchmark-supported but not null/power validated.

required_inputs: Null and planted panels with final cluster counts, true cluster counts, over/under split labels, and active calibration decisions.
required_outputs: Cluster-count control simulation with family-wise over-split and under-split endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when final cluster-count error meets a declared control target under null and planted settings.
blocks_method_claim_until: Local p-value diagnostics do not imply final cluster-count control.

required_inputs: Predeclared planted structures, effect sizes, sample sizes, feature families, and calibration states.
required_outputs: Power curves for split recovery, ARI, final cluster count, and support failure by effect size.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when planted power is reported with uncertainty and method constants fixed before evaluation.
blocks_method_claim_until: Benchmark ARI grids are not a locked power study.

required_inputs: Candidate biological datasets with preprocessing feasibility, ground truth, baselines, licensing, and manuscript relevance.
required_outputs: Application selection matrix and one locked analysis plan.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when one dataset is selected with reproducible preprocessing and comparison baselines.
blocks_method_claim_until: No real-data result can be manuscript-ready without this selection.

required_inputs: Generated outputs proposed for manuscript use with provenance, commit, seeds, run commands, and limitations.
required_outputs: Promoted-results manifest and wiki index coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when every promoted output has locked provenance and matches manuscript claims.
blocks_method_claim_until: Generated outputs remain candidate evidence until promoted.

required_inputs: Manuscript claims, assumption table rows, source-ledger statuses, and diagnostic-contract statuses.
required_outputs: Overclaim audit mapping every claim to theorem, validation artifact, diagnostic-only evidence, or future work.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when every approximation is labeled and no diagnostic-only result is phrased as production calibration.
blocks_method_claim_until: Submission text must wait for the overclaim audit.

required_inputs: Root selected-region margins, selected barycenter memberships, null-whitened signed distances, tie cells, and active sets.
required_outputs: Derivative/tangent-cone diagnostic comparing first-order selected-barycenter predictions to simulations.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when the selected barycenter map derivative predicts selected-region boundary behavior within a declared tolerance.
blocks_method_claim_until: Root margin geometry remains first-order descriptive until derivative validation passes.

required_inputs: Selected barycenter membership changes, selected projections, Tree-BH cells, sibling FDR/inflation decisions, and non-root focal contexts.
required_outputs: Full selected-law diagnostic with contribution attribution for projection, Tree-BH, sibling FDR, and barycenter membership.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when the combined selected-law variables explain held-out selected-ratio tails in admissible contexts.
blocks_method_claim_until: The barycentric identity remains local until lifted to the full selected law.

required_inputs: Matched selected-null and planted-nonnull panels with internal support labels, selected-hierarchy tails, and support-mixing controls.
required_outputs: Comparison table separating real selected-tail inflation from overpenalty caused by selected-nonnull support mixing.
acceptance_criteria: Pass when blockers are classified as true selected-tail inflation, support-mixing overpenalty, or unsupported context with stable criteria.
blocks_method_claim_until: Internal empirical-inflation blockers cannot be interpreted without this separation.
